subject: Dedicated capacity options & minimum GPU ladder — Aequora Labs
messages:
From: David Li <david.li@aequora.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyanka Suresh <priyanka@aequora.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity planning — short / medium term asks

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week. Aequora is evaluating a Dedicated reservation for production inference tied to our upcoming Gen2 model rollout. High level asks: predictable latency for 512-token requests, a minimum guaranteed capacity for our nightly batch scoring jobs, and a ramp plan that aligns with product milestone releases (Q3 launch, scale in Q4).

I've attached our demand forecast (AEQ-Demand-Profile.xlsx). Can you send a concise options set that shows: a small starter cluster (for pilot), a mid-tier production cluster, and a larger steady-state cluster — each with min GPUs, expected sustained throughput (reqs/sec at 512 tokens), prewarm credits, and an estimated monthly commitment price range. We also need an onboarding timeline and the fallback policy if we hit capacity limits.

Appreciate a short options matrix we can share with our procurement and infra leads.

Best,
David
SVP, Infrastructure
Aequora Labs

[attachment: AEQ-Demand-Profile.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: David Li <david.li@aequora.com>
Cc: Priyanka Suresh <priyanka@aequora.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity planning — concise option set attached

Hi David — thanks, and great to hear about the Gen2 rollout. Attached is a short Option Set (RBW-Proposal-OptionSet.pdf) summarizing three paths with pricing bands and operational notes. Key highlights inline below.

Option A — Pilot (3–6 month):
- Cluster: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (1 node), min guaranteed: 4 GPUs
- Throughput: ~18 reqs/sec @512 tokens (sustained, single-tenant)
- Prewarm credits: 50k tokens/month to mitigate cold starts during ramp
- Typical use: validation, low-traffic pilot, nightly batch fallback to host API
- Estimated monthly commitment: $26k–$34k

Option B — Production (initial steady):
- Cluster: 24 A100-equivalent GPUs (3 nodes), min guaranteed: 12 GPUs
- Throughput: ~55 reqs/sec @512 tokens (sustained, autoscale headroom)
- Prewarm credits: 200k tokens/month; 2 warm standbys for canary
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, regional redundancy recommended
- Estimated monthly commitment: $72k–$95k

Option C — Steady-state / Growth:
- Cluster: 64 A100-equivalent GPUs (8 nodes), min guaranteed: 32 GPUs
- Throughput: ~150 reqs/sec @512 tokens (sustained multi-tenant lanes)
- Prewarm credits: 500k tokens/month; hot spare lane for burst
- Ramp window: 8–12 weeks activation + warmup cadence to reach 80% utilization
- Estimated monthly commitment: $185k–$240k

Fallback & graceful degradation: auto-route overflow to compatible smaller model or to hosted API tier (configurable per-route). We recommend a canary rollout with traffic shadowing for the Q3 launch (2 weeks canary, then 4 week ramp).

I'll loop Kimberly (on ops/activation) and Aditya (on pricing/contracting) for specifics: Kimberly, can you confirm typical activation lead times for the Production and Growth options? Aditya, please flag any discounts or committed-burn structures we should propose.

Thanks — attaching the PDF for a compact slide to share.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachment: RBW-Proposal-OptionSet.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Li <david.li@aequora.com>, Priyanka Suresh <priyanka@aequora.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity planning — activation windows & guardrails

On Tue, Jun 18, 2028 at 10:05 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'll loop Kimberly (on ops/activation) and Aditya (on pricing/contracting) for specifics...

David / Priyanka — quick ops notes to make the timeline more concrete:
- Pilot (Option A): provisioning 2–3 business days for a single-node dedicated lane; validation/canary: ~1 week.
- Production (Option B): activation 3–4 weeks (scheduling GPU capacity, network peering, initial warmup). We allocate a 2-week warmup window where prewarm credits cover KV/prefix warming.
- Growth (Option C): 6–10 week activation depending on region and availability windows; if they need strict calendar dates we recommend a soft reserve 8 weeks ahead.
- Minimums and autoscale: min guaranteed GPUs take effect after the initial 30-day onboarding to prevent churn while we optimize batching.

Operational guardrails we recommend Aequora include:
- Rate limiting by route with failover to hosted API for bursts >20% of provisioned capacity.
- Scheduled maintenance windows with 72-hour notice for major changes and rolling upgrades.
- Monthly utilization review and a 10% tolerance-based bump/discount mechanism in the contract to smooth billing spikes.

I'll join the call if you want to walk through the activation checklist this week.

—Kimberly
Director, Activation & Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: David Li <david.li@aequora.com>, Priyanka Suresh <priyanka@aequora.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity planning — commercial note & next steps

Hi David / Priyanka — quick commercial follow-up.

Pricing knobs we can offer to align to Aequora's ramp:
- 12-month commit: ~8–12% discount off list (applies to Option B baseline).
- 24-month commit: ~15% discount + onboarding credits (applies to Option C).
- Stair-step activation: bill at 60% of committed minimum for the first 30 days, then move to full baseline as utilization signals steady traffic.

Contract addenda we typically include: prewarm credit consumption reporting, a capacity refund if Redwood fails to deliver allocated GPUs for >72 contiguous hours, and a playbook for data residency/KMS key handoff for private deployments.

If that sounds good, I'll generate a short statement-of-work + term sheet and send a DocuSign link. Proposed next step: 30-minute alignment call Thurs 6/22 to lock the Option (B recommended) and timeline.
